item.description:
Dax 3.5.0

  • Screen Markup: press Control–Option–M to capture a whole display and draw on it. Pen, highlighter, arrow, box, blur and text, with undo and redo, in a frozen capture or live over what the screen is doing. The result lands in the bottom-right image stack and uploads on its own, so a link is ready when you need one.
  • Screen Markup has its own Settings page: starting mode (frozen or live), which display, the first drawing tool, upload, keeping a copy in Pictures, and copying the image to the clipboard straight away. The earlier Control–Option–Shift–M shortcut moves to Control–Option–M automatically if nothing else has claimed it.
  • Agent settings are grouped into General, Tools and Permissions. Permission cards and agent connections are explained where you switch them on, with each agent’s hook status beside it.
  • A pane’s Copy Context and Copy Resume Command now live under Load Context instead of their own menu.
  • Retains 3.4.2’s sidebar, Ask AI, snipping and passkey behaviour, and 3.4.1’s paused graphical chat and lid-close support.

Coming from the previous Dax app identity? Install DaxPro with the DMG or PKG. Existing DaxPro installations update through the new feed.
